decisions.statement: HENUVOKODAN/HNK-KODE uses distinct layers for fundamental keys, glyph address space, generative geometry, HNK40 genesis/validation, PATH formation, glyph composition, lexemes and language composition.
decisions.notes: Do not collapse 463 addressable fields into 463 phonetic letters.

decisions.statement: AHNUVA, EMANU, HAYA, HODERU and KODAN are recovered as HNK-KODE lexemes.
decisions.notes: Exact meanings and approval chronology require separate source evidence.

decisions.statement: The 40 HNK40 glyphs are a genesis/validation set and must not be mechanically treated as the first forty cells of a 463-unit alphabet.
Recovered Mandala counts are 432 MF = 72 sectors x 6 layers; 463 ACTIVE = 432 MF + 9 EXTERNAL + 22 CENTER; 504 RASTER = 463 ACTIVE + 41 RESERVED.
decisions.notes: This does not assign semantics to every field.

decisions.statement: Mandala-HNK is a structural/computational foundation of HNK-KODE; later recovered architecture treats it as Encoding + Grammar + Computational Substrate.
decisions.notes: Preserve earlier hypothesis stages rather than retroactively relabelling them.

decisions.statement: A glyph may be represented by a PATH over addressable cells rather than one cell alone; recovered model includes START_CELL + PATH + EDGE_SEQUENCE + TRANSFORM.
Mathematical or topological validity does not automatically create linguistic canon.
decisions.notes: Human promotion remains separate from structural validation.

decisions.statement: HNK-VERSE is a platform/metaverse consumer; HNK-KODE is the language and fullstack-language product; CODEX-HNK is central authority/record; HNK-KODE is not a submodule of HNK-VERSE.
TEHKNE-OS is the technological codex of Tehkne Solutions and is not a metacenter above CODEX-HNK.

Recovered architecture links textual, structural and glyphic representations through AST and HNK-IR, while Mandala/PATH semantics must be formally defined rather than assigned merely to fill the address space.

known_gaps: Exact source-backed semantic definitions and promotion chronology for AHNUVA, EMANU, HAYA, HODERU and KODAN remain to be extracted.
Current Project-file search did not recover authoritative source text for the previously tracked reject/watch lexemes; provenance must not be fabricated.
Item-level HNK40 provenance and E4/E5 transition remain to be extracted.
KODESCRIPT/MHCM design must be compared with current repository packages, tests and contracts before implementation status is asserted.
